2. Structural Collapse (Severity 1.0): The Router noted muddying at the wing/neck junction. The Animal Pose Auditor flagged HIGH risk (41% low confidence keypoints) specifically in the Face and Front Limbs/Shoulder region. This confirms the Router's observation of structural ambiguity/fusion in that area.
